note: flags from an independent visual reviewer who looked at the compare images

flags.problem: Battlement (wall_side) flat graphic keeps its shape, but cutout edges are soft with a faint dark-purple fringe at 1:1.
flags.fix: Re-threshold or hard-sharpen the alpha edge so magenta cutouts meet grey with no dark fringe; keep the flat colours.

flags.problem: DRYDOCK lettering keeps its double-outline design, but glyph edges are soft with a glow/halo at 1:1, not crisp flat art.
flags.fix: Snap the lettering alpha to a crisp edge (or use a hard-cut alpha) and remove the glow so the outline stays sharp.

flags.problem: Gun turret keeps its shape and orange lights, but the painted metal reads as speckled film-grain noise at 1:1, with a dark fringe along the diagonal cut-out edge.
flags.fix: Lower the lab-inject amplitude on the metal areas, use lower-frequency brushed-metal grain, and remove the dark matte fringe on the diagonal edge.

flags.problem: Yellow fabric colour and seam ticks match, but the injected weave is a regular checker/grid pattern at 1:1 that looks like a screen or stamp, not fabric.
flags.fix: Replace the periodic weave with non-periodic fine noise, reduce its amplitude, and remove the grid so it reads as woven cloth.

flags.problem: Blue fabric colour matches the original, but the same regular checker/grid weave is visible at 1:1 and reads as a repeated stamp.
flags.fix: Same as dtzepskin1: non-periodic weave noise at lower amplitude, no visible grid.

flags.problem: Blue and yellow stripe composition is kept, but a checkerboard overlay is visible on the blue panel at 1:1 and fit view, a repeated artifact absent from the original.
flags.fix: Remove the checker/tile weave from the lab-inject and use non-periodic fine noise limited to luminance; keep the stripes and the dark diagonal line.
